name: distributed-reviewer-prompt
body:
The distributed `implementation-phase-reviewer` agent prompt file `opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md` (product source embedded into the `apg` binary via `include_str!` in `rust.apg.install`'s `AGENTS` table and installed by `apg init` into `~/.config/opencode/agents/`), the product-source peer of the repo's own consumer artifact `.opencode/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md` (read for the grant shape and body; that consumer copy is a consumer artifact). Frontmatter `mode: subagent`, `hidden: true`, with `generated: true` absent; the grants are the read-only apg suite, the plan read tools, and `apg_review`/`apg_review_add`/`apg_review_resolve`/`apg_review_reject` + `apg_plan_complete`, with `question`, edit, scan, done/undone/note, authoring and `apg_plan_render` all absent; the body carries the positive read-guard rule and stop-and-report.

Deliberately a NARROW owner: the file gets its own component, and the broad `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance` spans the two existing prompt files and is realised-by the unrelated `domain.entity.graph-first-navigation`. It is product source in `solution.container.opencode-suite`; the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts.

implemented-by: (1) the file `opencode-suite/agents/implementation-phase-reviewer.md`, declared as a planned File node by `agent-builder-roster-cleanup/plan` and pending until the implementer creates it (the deferred edge; see `solution.note.distributed-reviewer-deferred-edge`); and (2) the read-guard coherence test `rust.main_e2e.e2e.installed_agent_prompts_state_file_access_read_guard`, which asserts this prompt's read-guard (its five-prompt list names `implementation-phase-reviewer.md`).
